Figure 4. Recorded 12-lead ECG examples across age-transfer settings. (A) A conduction-positive young-adult ECG detected by the unchanged older-adult model. (B) A positive child ECG detected by older-adult fine-tuning but missed by training from scratch. (C) A positive infant ECG missed by both approaches. Traces show 10-second, 100 Hz recordings, mean-centered on a shared voltage scale. Cases were selected using a fixed rule based on model outcomes. Pediatric decisions use held-out predictions and validation-selected thresholds. Labels await clinician review. These examples illustrate individual decisions; Figure 3 reports cohort-level performance. Pediatric findings remain exploratory.
